supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS activity is consistently associated in the endpoint and proxy records with C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe connecting through the proxy to updates.pixelforge-suite.com. The observed attempts occur at approximately five-minute intervals from 13:37 through 14:07 UTC.
The observed executable path and destination match the inventory's approved PixelForge updater and its expected update-check domain and roughly five-minute cadence.
The 13:42:31 attempt to the same update domain received proxy status 407 (authentication required); the endpoint records associate the attempt with pfupdater.exe.
The updater process exited at 14:08 UTC, consistent with the end of the observed periodic activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels, not the encrypted application contents; the records do not establish what data, if any, was exchanged inside them.

The process-to-proxy association is based on matching timestamps, destination proxy, and endpoint process/network records; the available records do not include a TLS inspection result or executable hash/signature verification.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish the contents or purpose of the encrypted update traffic beyond the CONNECT destination.
The records do not independently verify the integrity or authenticity of the updater binary.
unrelated_findings: Separate review recommended: sam.okafor credentials were used in a network logon on WS-SOKAFOR-01 with WS-LMARTINS-01 recorded as the originating workstation, which differs from the inventory practice that remote administration is performed from WS-SOKAFOR-01. This is not evidence that the alerted PixelForge connections were malicious. (T046-00023, T046-00024)

Separate review recommended: FILE-NWD-01 initiated an RPC connection to WS-LMARTINS-01 on port 135 during the review window. The records do not establish the RPC operation or its purpose. (T046-00063, T046-00067, T046-00068, T046-00069)

Separate software review recommended: DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM, and a nearby DNS query resolved x7k9m2.akamaized.net; the available records do not tie that query to the PixelForge updater or show a corresponding external connection. (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00124, T046-00126, T046-00127, T046-00128)
